verdicts.note: The 840 K value is the calculated spinodal temperature, not the upper temperature studied; simulations also examined clustering and deformation at 1,000 K and other temperatures.
The Al-Ni Warren-Cowley SRO parameter diverges at k=[000]; the paper does not say that the interchange energy itself diverges.
The >1.17 A2 threshold is attributed to prior experiments, while this paper predicts A2 only above x=1.25; it also does not establish that clustering ceases above x=1.17.
